description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeLeaveModel in the OrangeHRM leave management plugin's API layer. It implements serialization and normalization functionality for EmployeeLeave entities, facilitating their transformation into API responses with detailed annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing and normalizing leave data associated with an employee, used in API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a Leave entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
